_comment: See RULES.md RULE-04 (superseded twice): Azure Document Intelligence (prebuilt-layout) is now the primary extraction engine, replacing Azure OpenAI gpt-5-mini — 14s for a full 4-page statement vs. 90-180s per page, with equivalent table structure/column coverage on the same sample document. Deterministic pdfplumber (with internal OCR fallback for scanned pages) remains the non-AI last resort, unchanged. azure_gpt5_mini/azure_gpt5_nano/azure_gpt5_1 config paths are kept registered for direct get_ai_client() access but are not part of the active chain, pending a separate cleanup pass to remove them.
